title: NEC (NFPA 70) 2023, Article 630 electric welders: 630.8, 630.12 and 630.13

values.next_higher_standard: where the values determined by 630.12 do not correspond to the standard ampere ratings of 240.6, or the rating or setting results in unnecessary opening of the overcurrent device, the next higher standard rating or setting is permitted
values.welder_alternative: if I1max is not given, not more than 200 percent of the rated primary current of the welder
values.separate_device_not_required: an overcurrent device is not required for a welder whose supply conductors are protected at not more than 200 percent of I1max or at the rated primary current
values.i1max_note: I1max is the maximum value of the rated supply current at maximum rated output
values.i1eff_note: I1eff is the maximum value of the effective supply current, calculated from the rated supply current (I1), the corresponding duty cycle (X) and the supply current at no-load (I0)

sources.doc: CMP-12 Second Draft, 2026 cycle (A2025), Second Revision 7788
sources.note: the whole of 630.12 with 'overcurrent device' struck for 'OCPD'; struck and unmarked text is the 2023 text (no First Revision on 630.12)

sources.doc: CMP-12 public inputs, 2026 cycle (A2025), Public Input 2333

values.required: a disconnecting means in the supply circuit for each arc welder not equipped with an integral disconnect
values.type: a switch, circuit breaker, or listed cord-and-plug connector
values.rating: not less than that necessary to accommodate the overcurrent protection of 630.12

sources.doc: CMP-12 Second Draft statements, 2023 cycle (A2022), Second Revision 7589

values.receptacles: 125-volt, 15- and 20-ampere receptacles for electrical hand tools or portable lighting equipment, supplied by single-phase branch circuits rated 150 volts or less to ground
values.where: work areas where welders are operated

sources.doc: CMP-12 public inputs, 2026 cycle (A2025), Public Inputs 2238, 243 and 577 (each proposes deleting 630.8 and prints its 2023 text struck)
